mechanism_narrative: Sustained four-week upward trend in GROCERY_PHARM mobility (from -9.0 to +11.3) signals normalization of essential shopping patterns. failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean over the last 28 days, or GROCERY_PHARM reverses by more than 5 points in week t+1.
